idea_dispositions.reason: The roads layer and ACS tract polygons exist, and the road schema includes geometry. However, the current audited input API only exposes named-class tract lengths, not line-to-tract-boundary distances or 25 m boundary-buffer intersections. Adding those study-geometry operations without a dedicated audited accessor and deterministic boundary-touch tests risks implementing a different recipe or leaking geometry reads outside the declaration contract.
idea_dispositions.missing_prerequisite: A tested, declared geometry accessor for named-class road lines and tract boundaries plus deterministic boundary-buffer clipping tests for the specified 25 m recipe.

idea_dispositions.reason: The roads schema exposes names, access_restrictions, routes and geometry, but the current cache/input method returns tract-level lengths and discards segment identity, heading and paired-line candidates. The <60 m/opposite-heading/same-name-or-route pairing rule needs a separate segment-level access contract and false-pair tests for ramps/frontage roads before its per-tract variants can be emitted.
idea_dispositions.missing_prerequisite: A declared segment-level roads reader, frozen heading derivation and validated dual-carriageway pairing tests (including ramps and frontage roads).

idea_dispositions.reason: The recipe's denominator a_ref is the median of Microsoft-only footprints. Microsoft US Buildings is a removed reference layer and is explicitly forbidden on study tracts; substituting an Overture source-tagged Microsoft-equivalent layer would still use that prohibited reference copy to construct a target-like deficit.
idea_dispositions.missing_prerequisite: A rule-clean alternate definition that does not use Microsoft/reference footprints, or an operator-approved removal of this recipe; no reference-layer retrieval or computation is permitted.

idea_dispositions.reason: The buildings layer has geometry, but the preregistered void recipe also requires excluding cells with park/school POIs and near water infrastructure. The registered places layer is absent at the provided-package path, and there is no audited 100 m grid/ring or park/water masking implementation. Counting those voids without the specified exclusions would conflate parks and fields with tile dropout.
idea_dispositions.missing_prerequisite: Provided, audited POI and water-feature inputs plus deterministic 100 m cell occupancy, eight-neighbour ring, and exclusion-mask tests.

idea_dispositions.reason: The registered Overture places path returned FileNotFound for eastern-ok during schema-only availability inspection. Without per-place geometry and names, exact-coordinate stacks, distinct-name counts and the 3 km exported mass cannot be computed. No tract join or geometry measurement was attempted.
idea_dispositions.missing_prerequisite: A verified, rule-clean provided places layer with geometry and names in all four regions, then an audited point/tract and 3 km allocation contract.

orthogonality.interpretation: No G correlation or VIF is claimed because no G estimator was computed. Existing implemented estimators remain measured in the refreshed report.
